caption: Utagawa Hiroshige, Cooling off in the Evening at Shijogawara (c. 1834)
alt: A woodblock print of an evening by a river in Kyoto: people in kimono sit and drink on a low wooden platform by the bright blue water, with lantern-lit teahouses along the far bank and grey hills beyond.
bibliography: Hiroshige, Utagawa. Cooling Off in the Evening at Shijogawara. c. 1834, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York.
title: Cooling off in the Evening at Shijogawara
